addPayment.title: Add a Payment Method
addPayment.description: You are on a free trial. Choose a plan and register your card now to keep using LINCE after the trial ends.

changePlan.title: Change Plan
changePlan.description: Upgrade or downgrade at any time. Charges are prorated.
changePlan.upgradeNote: When upgrading, you will be charged the prorated difference immediately.
changePlan.downgradeNote: When downgrading, a prorated credit will be applied to your next invoice.
changePlan.confirmUpgradeMsg: You will be charged the prorated difference now and moved to the {{plan}} plan ({{price}}/month).
changePlan.confirmDowngradeMsg: You will be moved to the {{plan}} plan ({{price}}/month). A prorated credit will be applied to your next invoice.
